name: Renas AI – AI Content Generator, Blog Writer, Image Creator & Chatbot
author: renasai

sections.description:
Renas AI Content Generator brings the power of artificial intelligence directly into your WordPress dashboard. Create high-quality blog posts, generate stunning images, rewrite existing content, and enhance your workflow — all without leaving WordPress.

Key Features:

  • Blog Wizard — Create complete blog posts in 4 easy steps: set your topic, choose a title, review the outline, and generate. Supports fast, advanced, and bulk modes.
  • Content Templates — 35+ ready-made templates for product descriptions, social media posts, emails, ads, and more.
  • Image Generator — Generate AI images with multiple models (DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, Flux) and save them directly to your Media Library.
  • AI Chat — Full-page chat interface with multiple conversations, model selection, and server-side storage.
  • Auto-Post — Schedule and automate blog post generation on a recurring basis.
  • Content Rewriter — Rewrite existing posts or any text with AI to improve quality or change style.
  • Content Refresh — Update and refresh outdated content to keep it relevant and SEO-friendly.
  • Editor Actions — Rewrite, summarize, translate, fix grammar, change tone, and more. Works with Classic Editor and Gutenberg Block Editor.
  • Gutenberg Sidebar — AI actions directly in the block editor sidebar for seamless content editing.
  • SEO Scorer — Client-side SEO analysis with 13 criteria (0-100 score) — uses zero credits.
  • 10+ AI Models — Choose from GPT-5, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and more. Each with different speed and quality trade-offs.
  • SEO Friendly — Auto-generates meta descriptions, SEO titles, and focus keywords. Compatible with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO.
  • Multi-language — Generate content in 40+ languages.
  • Content History — Track all AI generations with search, filtering, and full content preview.
  • Credit System — Pay only for what you use. No monthly subscriptions required.
  • WooCommerce Integration — Generate AI product descriptions directly from the product edit screen.
  • Elementor Integration — AI text generation button inside the Elementor editor.

How It Works:

  1. Install the plugin and connect your free Renas AI account.
  2. Use the Blog Wizard to generate complete blog posts.
  3. Generate AI images for your content.
  4. Use Editor Actions or the Gutenberg Sidebar to enhance existing text.
  5. Chat with AI for brainstorming, research, or any writing task.

All AI processing happens on Renas AI servers. Your API key is encrypted at rest and never exposed to the browser.

Third-Party Service:

This plugin connects to the Renas AI external service for AI content generation, credit management, and account authentication. When you use any AI feature (blog generation, image generation, chat, etc.), your request is sent to the Renas AI API at https://renas.ai/api/v1/wp/ for processing. No user-generated content is stored on Renas AI servers — all content is saved entirely in your WordPress installation.

  • Renas AI Website
  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the renas-ai folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Renas AI → Settings and click Connect to Renas AI.
  4. Create a free account at renas.ai if you don’t have one.
  5. Authorize the connection and start creating content!
sections.faq:
Do I need a Renas AI account?

Yes. You need a free Renas AI account to use the plugin. Sign up at renas.ai/register.

How does the credit system work?

Each AI operation costs a certain number of credits. Title generation costs 5 credits, outline generation costs 25 credits, and blog post generation varies based on length and model. You can purchase credits at renas.ai/pricing.

Which AI models are supported?

The plugin supports 10+ AI models including GPT-5, GPT-5 Mini, Claude Sonnet, Claude Haiku, Gemini Pro, Gemini Flash, Grok, and more. Each model has different speed, quality, and cost characteristics.

Does it work with the Block Editor (Gutenberg)?

Yes. The Blog Wizard and Image Generator work with any editor. The Gutenberg Sidebar provides AI actions (rewrite, translate, summarize, etc.) directly in the block editor. Classic Editor is also fully supported.

Is my API key secure?

Yes. Your API key is encrypted with AES-256-CBC using WordPress security salts and stored in the database. It is never sent to the browser — all API calls go through your WordPress server.

Can I generate content in languages other than English?

Yes. The plugin supports 40+ languages for content generation.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. When WooCommerce is active, the plugin adds an AI metabox to product edit screens for generating product descriptions.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes. When Elementor is active, the plugin adds an AI generation button inside the Elementor editor for quick text generation.

What is the SEO Scorer?

The SEO Scorer analyzes your generated content against 13 SEO criteria and gives a 0-100 score with color-coded feedback. It runs entirely in the browser and uses zero credits.
